days.title: Braies Lakes and High Plateaus
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: lago di Braies
stops.detail: The main lakes of the park are: Lake Braies, Lake Dobbiaco, the Le de Fojedöra, Lake Limo, Lake Piciodel and Lake de Rufiedo.

stops.name: Prato Piazza
stops.detail: The peaks reach heights of 3,000 m a.s.l. and overlook the vast plateaus of Fanes, Sennes, Fosses and Prato Piazza (Plätzwiese).

stops.name: forte Prato Piazza
stops.detail: Inside the park there is also an old Austro-Hungarian fort dating back to the First World War, the Prato Piazza fort.

stops.name: le de Fojedöra
stops.detail: From here, in half an hour you reach Lake Le de Fojedöra (It. lake of the Alpe dei Colli Alti, Ger. Hochalpen-See, 2252 m).

stops.name: lago di Limo
stops.detail: Continuing along trail no. 11, you climb for about another 20 minutes and arrive at Lake Limo (2154 m).

stops.name: centro visite del parco naturale
stops.detail: In San Vigilio di Marebbe, a visitor center of the nature park has been built, with free access, which collects information and curiosities about the park in a suggestive wooden building.
